prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism: top-rank state-surface momentum names that remain near 60d highs at expiry show continued leadership (SNXX/CRDO forward rows; convexity of catalysts landing on extended leaders). Prior evidence is adverse: exp-20260518-001 rejected all fixed hold horizons and exit_policy family accepts only 16.7%; this differs by conditioning extension on a PIT near-high state at expiry rather than retuning the global hold. Main disconfirmer: giveback after expiry and capacity blocking may erase the tail gains, and the state_surface hard bar requires >10% aggregate EV lift.
